thread:
Mike (Finance): heads-up — during today's pricewave import I spotted ~2% of invoices flagged as grandfathered but they didn’t get the legacy rate applied. looks like a mapping miss between vendor_sheet v2 and our cohort keys. can someone sanity-check? :eyes:
Sophie (Product): which cohort keys are affected? is this only new pricewave cohorts or also older ones?
Tom (Billing): ran a quick extract on the flagged invoices. sample rows below (sanitized):
```
account_id,old_tier,new_tier,grandfathered_flag,applied_rate
acct_1023,pro,standard,true,STANDARD_RATE
acct_8877,enterprise,pro,true,PRO_RATE
acct_5501,pro,pro,true,PRO_RATE
```
Tom (Billing): you can see applied_rate != legacy rate in first two rows. last one looks fine.
Anya (Ops): any recent changes to the ingestion script or vendor sheet schema? I didn't touch the mapper yesterday.
Mike (Finance): vendor_sheet_v2 added a column `legacy_cohort_code` last night, and the import script was updated to prefer `cohort_code` over `legacy_cohort_code` if present. looks like some vendor rows have legacy set but cohort_code blank.
Sophie (Product): ok that explains it. current rollout plan flips pricewave for 20% of traffic tomorrow at 08:00 UTC. recommend we pause the flip until we confirm mapping fix or add a patch that falls back to legacy_cohort_code.
Jess (Sales): heads-up — there are a few customers flagged for grandfathering with big invoices. if we delay, can we proactively notify impacted accounts?
Mike (Finance): yes pls. also need to estimate total credit exposure if we have to retroactively apply legacy rates for affected invoices. Tom, can you run a sum of delta for accounts with invoices in last 30d?
Tom (Billing): will do. rough query: `SELECT sum((legacy_rate-applied_rate)*tokens) FROM invoices WHERE grandfathered=true AND created_at > now()-interval '30 days'` — running now.
billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-4721: "pricewave import mapping fallback and recon for grandfathered invoices" assigned to @Anya (Ops).
Anya (Ops): I'll push a quick mapper patch to fallback to `legacy_cohort_code` when `cohort_code` is null. plan: deploy to canary, re-run import for last 48h only, and produce a diff report. ETA 2 hours.
Sophie (Product): for rollout gating: hold the 20% flip. we should only resume after: 1) fallback deployed to prod canary, 2) recon report reviewed by finance, 3) customer outreach plan approved.
Mike (Finance): agreed. add threshold: if estimated credit exposure > $5k, require exec sign-off and vendor confirmation.
Jess (Sales): I'll draft a short note for affected customers and queue it for legal review.
Tom (Billing): query finished — provisional delta = $3,750 for last 30d (sample). full recon after Anya's run will give exact.
Anya (Ops): deployed fallback to canary at 16:45 UTC. re-importing 48h window now. logs: `INFO reimport: 48h window, 4,312 rows processed, 92 rows changed mapping`
Tom (Billing): recon diff arriving — 92 invoices updated, total credit delta = $4,120. attaching report in FIN-4721.
Mike (Finance): still under $5k so no exec sign-off needed, but we should proceed with customer outreach for those 92 accounts.
Sophie (Product): ok i'll unblock the 20% flip to run in non-overlapping cohorts once we confirm no more schema issues. recommend adding a monitoring alert: alert if grandfathered=true and applied_rate != legacy_rate for any invoice.
Anya (Ops): added alert rule in PagerDuty: `finance.grandfathered.rate_mismatch` — threshold: 1 mismatch in 10m -> page on duty.
Jess (Sales): draft customer note ready, linking FIN-4721. can we target outreach tomorrow morning PST?
Mike (Finance): yes. thanks team. final checklist: hold flip (done), deployed fallback (done canary->prod patch pending), recon done, outreach drafted. reopening flip once we get a thumbs up from finance. :thumbsup:
